instruction: A cave entrance in a rock face: a dark recessed opening under a believable rock overhang, damp-looking layered rock transitions around the mouth, and scattered rubble and boulders at the base. Human-walkable scale.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a cave entrance. A cave entrance in a rock face: a dark recessed opening under a believable rock overhang, damp-looking layered rock transitions around the mouth, and scattered rubble and boulders at the base. Human-walkable scale. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
